summary: T1 item 8, analog partition: sim/characterization-analog-summary.md is the one aggregated, current artifact summarizing the analog partition (regions ring1, ring2 and combiner_sampler, as declared in the manifest's partition_boundary.analog) against each applicable row of the ratified target specification. Each entry names its PVT corner or scope, the sim/records/ evidence it rests on, the sim/tools/ derivation that reads it (power_rollup.py, time_to_first_valid.py, worst_corner_entropy.py), its evidence class (measured, measured-extracted, derived, target arithmetic, estimate or unmeasured) and its claim limit. sim/tests/test_analog_characterization_summary.py holds every quoted row-level figure to those tools' current output. This envelope asserts that the aggregation artifact required by item 8 EXISTS and is CURRENT for the pinned revision of that document. It does NOT assert that any row in it passes. Every figure is simulation, not silicon, and none is an SP 800-90B entropy assessment. Disclosed limits that travel with this claim rather than being omitted from it: (a) raw rate: the DR-0007 sizing law holds at the entropy-binding corner ss/125C/3.63V only up to 678-8810 bps depending on the jitter-energy constant, 114x-1475x below DR-0003's original, superseded 1 Mbps (the ratified raw rate is now 2 kbps, DR-0011; at 2 kbps the law holds for the starved-cell constants and not for the plain-cell 678 bps, a derived comparison), and no transistor-level bitstream at either rate exists; (b) raw min-entropy per bit is unmeasured, not supportable by transistor-level simulation at any rate under consideration, and the Tier 2 quality estimate is therefore not delivered; (c) power, at the historical 1 Mbps (rate-scaled derivation at the current 2 kbps: 418.5 uW, a lower bound, in the summary's section 1.1): the analog terms are 410 uW active (82.0% of the row) and 32.77 nA idle pre-layout (127.04 nA full-chip extracted, superseded by 128.83 nA against the refreshed PEX netlist, issue #739), but the whole-block rows are missed, at 758.2 uW (151.6%) and 2.211 uA (221%), on the digital section's gate-level power and leakage; (d) area: the analog regions are 14.05% of the row and the whole-block row is missed; (e) post-layout extraction is a floor, not a ceiling: 12 of 14 inter-region nets are not simulated, and at DR-0010's superseded 500 bps (historical) the sizing margin at a = 1.79 falls from 1.356x pre-layout to 0.374x full-chip; (f) fs/sf process corners are uncovered for the array, Monte Carlo covers two PVT points, and the coupling and bit-bias studies are single-corner. This envelope does not restate the status of any other T1 item: the verdict of record is signoff/records/t1-tier-report.json. In particular, item 7 (post-layout) for the analog partition is graded there on the native klt pex envelope over ring1, which covers ring1 only and is body-bias limited (body_bias.status unbiased); that citation is separate from this item 8 aggregate, and an existing characterization aggregate is not the same thing as passing specification rows. See signoff/README.md for the full reading.
